messages:
Aisha Patel: Hi @Rory (People Ops) — I need a recurring scheduling accommodation for medical follow-ups: every other Friday 12:30-13:30 for the next 3 months. This overlaps with my on-call handoff on those Fridays. Can we adjust my on-call shifts or make a temporary swap? Prefer confidentiality.

Rory (People Ops): Hey Aisha — we can help. Two options: 1) temporary on-call swap for those dates, coordinated with your team lead; 2) short-term exemption with coverage plan documented. Do you already have dates? Also, do you want us to file an ADA accommodation intake?

Aisha Patel: I'll send the exact dates (starting 2026-04-03). Yes please file intake — I'd rather have it on record but kept private.

Ben M.: @Aisha Patel I can cover the handoffs on the alternating Fridays if that helps. Happy to swap a couple weeks with you.

Rory (People Ops): Filing intake now. Link sent: https://intra.redwood/hr/ada-request — you can upload a provider note or short explanation. We'll open Case ID HR-2026-198 and keep details limited to People Ops and your manager only.

oncall-bot: [Automated] On-call schedule overlap detected for Aisha Patel on 2026-04-03 12:30 UTC. Please confirm coverage swap or submit coverage plan.

Aisha Patel: Thanks Ben — that would help a lot. Rory, does marking this as an accommodation affect my eligibility for the upcoming performance calibration in May? I want to avoid any misunderstandings about my availability.

Rory (People Ops): It should not affect calibration. Accommodations are protected and confidential. We recommend documenting the coverage plan so managers can see coverage was arranged and not mark missed handoffs as a performance gap. If you'd like, we can add a neutral note to calibration packet clarifying schedule exceptions without medical detail.

Ben M.: Confirmed — I'll take the handoff on 2026-04-03 and 2026-04-17. Aisha, DM me the exact handoff checklist so I don't miss anything.

Aisha Patel: Sent the checklist. Also asking if workload re-prioritization for those Fridays is possible (fewer synchronous tasks). That would help reduce pressure on days I need appointments.

Rory (People Ops): We can coordinate temporary workload adjustments with your manager. I'll propose a 4-week trial of slightly reduced syncs on those Fridays and check back before calibration. If anything shifts we can document it in the accommodation case.

Aisha Patel: Appreciate it. One more Q — will this be visible to peers in calendar or org tools? Prefer to keep personal details private.

Rory (People Ops): We'll mark events as "Private — Appointment" and only People Ops and your manager will see the case. Peers will only see blocked time with no details.

oncall-bot: [Automated] Coverage swap request logged: HR-2026-198. Please confirm in-thread once swaps are complete.

Ben M.: Swaps updated in on-call tool and I confirmed coverage.

Aisha Patel: Thanks everyone. I submitted the provider note and confirmed the swaps. Keeping fingers crossed for a smooth few months.

Rory (People Ops): Case HR-2026-198 updated. We'll do a 2-week check-in after the first appointment; optional 10-min touch base if you want to tweak logistics. Confidentiality maintained. :lock:
